full_details: A boy in Southampton's livery left a black-letter folio at the street door and did not come up. The slip says lent, not given, and prove the proverb false. Mistress Ansell carried it up to feel the weight. It went on the board, not into the coffer. You stood at the Knight's Tale until the bell for nine, with Golding and Plutarch beside it, three Athenses, and Verona still in the house. On the tables you wrote a duke to be married, four days, the old moon. By noon Gib had left Holinshed and taken the Chaucer. You did not start a page of your own.
one_sentence: You took a lent Chaucer at the door and read the Knight's Tale until nine.
title: A lent Chaucer at the door
